observations: Photo shows a PlayStation 4 console box (text visible: 'PS4' on the box front).
Two DualShock-style controllers are shown in front of the box.
Cables are visible (power/AV/USB-type), but no console itself is clearly shown powered on.
No clear photo of the PS4 Pro model label/serial, and no close-up of the console faceplate.
No game disc/case or storage capacity label is visible.

claims.evidence: Photo shows 'PS4' on the box, but no clear 'Pro' marking or console model label/faceplate close-up.
Performance claims cannot be verified from the photo.

risks.risk: It may be a standard PS4 (not Pro), since only 'PS4' is clearly visible on the box and the console model label is not shown.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console model number label (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) or the console faceplate showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard PS4 bundle (worst case vs 'Pro').

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have faults (disc drive, HDMI port, overheating), since the photo does not show it tested/working.
risks.proof: Video clip of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen and showing a game loading (or system settings screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until proven.

risks.risk: Controllers may have issues (drift, non-responsive buttons), since no testing is shown.
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller input test (button presses) and analog stick movement without drift.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controllers may need repair/replacement.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete bundle (e.g., no original power cable, no HDMI, no controller charging cable), since only some cables are visible.
risks.proof: Photo laid out showing every included item with a count (power cable, HDMI, USB cable(s), headset if any).

risks.risk: Storage size and account status (possible banned/locked console) are unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of System Settings -> Storage and System Settings -> Users/Sign-in status (or a factory reset confirmation).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming unknown storage and potential account lock risk.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the PS4 console model number label (CUH-xxxx) to confirm Pro vs standard.
Video of the console booting to the PS4 home screen (and ideally launching a game).
Video/input test for both controllers (buttons + analog sticks).
Clear laid-out photo listing all included accessories (power, HDMI, USB cables, etc.).
Photo of System Settings showing storage capacity.
response.reason: The photo suggests a PS4 bundle with two controllers, but it does not clearly confirm 'PS4 Pro' or show that the console/controllers are working. Missing model identification and testing prevents a confident worst-case price.
